comment: CAPTURED legacy GET /v1/keys/{userId} response. Captured by running the previous handler against DynamoDB Local with the deterministic user below (registrationId 4242, testIdentityKey(7) for every key field, empty one-time-prekey pool). accounts-roster.test.ts recreates exactly this state and compares the LIVE handler's response to these bytes — statusCode, headers, and the body STRING — so 'a solo target's bundle stays byte-identical to the legacy shape' is asserted against a capture, never by field-presence. Do not regenerate casually: a diff here IS the old-client-visible drift the assertion exists to catch.
